conflicts.subject: feat(server): serve paginated child work (#195)
conflicts.resolution: Additive union across three regions. Upstream adds `ThreadActivityKindsLookupInput` and `listThreadActivityRowsByThreadAndKinds` for kind-filtered thread detail; the fork adds `AgentMembershipLookupInput`, `ProjectionAgentMembershipRowSchema`, `AgentActivityWindowLookupInput`, `getAgentMembershipRow`, and `listAgentActivityRows` for per-agent child work. Both sides landed adjacent declarations, so git split one seam into three markers; the shared `SELECT` column list was duplicated into each query body verbatim. No declaration, SQL predicate, or consumer was dropped: each of the five names resolves to exactly one declaration and one call site.

conflicts.subject: feat(server): serve paginated child work (#195)
conflicts.resolution: rerere replay reviewed and accepted. Interface-only file: the resolution keeps upstream's `activityKinds?` field on `ProjectionThreadDetailQuery` and adds the fork's `OrchestrationAgentActivityWindow`, `OrchestrationThreadDetailPage`, and `OrchestrationThreadActivity` imports, the `ProjectionAgentActivitySnapshot` interface, and the `getAgentActivitySnapshot` member. Pure addition on both sides, no member removed or retyped.

conflicts.subject: feat(files): reveal ignored workspace files (#73)
conflicts.resolution: upstream moved thread settling server-side and dropped `sidebarAutoSettleAfterDays` and `sidebarAutoSettleOnMerge` from the desktop client-settings defaults. The fork commit only adds `showIgnoredFiles`, so kept that line alone and let upstream's removal stand.

conflicts.subject: feat(files): reveal ignored workspace files (#73)
conflicts.resolution: upstream replaced the device-preference auto-settle switch with a per-connection `EnvironmentAutoSettleSwitch`. Kept upstream's connection list and its map, kept only the fork's `showIgnoredFiles` read and its Show ignored files row, and dropped the fork's now-superseded auto-settle switch.

conflicts.subject: feat(files): reveal ignored workspace files (#73)
conflicts.resolution: same seam in three spots: the preference type, the sanitizer's local type, and the sanitizer branch. Kept the fork's `showIgnoredFiles` in each and dropped `autoSettleOnMerge`, which upstream no longer stores per device.

conflicts.subject: feat(web): scope pull requests to project windows
conflicts.resolution: upstream's deferred line-stats change derives `statsPolicy` from the sort in the single page component; the fork splits that component so the route view is a thin wrapper. Moved the derivation next to the `sort` it reads, inside `PullRequestsPage`, which is where every consumer already lives.

conflicts.subject: feat(issues): add GitHub Issues surface scoped to project windows
conflicts.resolution: upstream hoisted `PullRequestServiceLive` earlier in the file, so the fork's hunk re-added it as a duplicate alongside its own `GitHubIssueServiceLive`. Kept only `GitHubIssueServiceLive`; the file now declares each layer once and both are still provided at the same call site.

conflicts.subject: fix(web): add Issues to right-panel launchers (#193)
conflicts.resolution: upstream moved thread settling to the server and deleted the client-side change-request memo the fork's hunk carried as context. Kept only the fork's `issuesSurfaceAvailable`, which its two launcher call sites still read; the deleted memo has no remaining reference in either tree.

conflicts.subject: fix(web): retain completed thread timing
conflicts.resolution: doc comment only; the hunk contains no code. Upstream shortened the header after settled-state resolution moved to the server, so took upstream's wording. The fork's remaining consumers are sidebar and chat labels, which it still covers, and the UTC boundary note it drops is restated at the timer.

conflicts.subject: feat(web): add manual sidebar thread ordering
conflicts.resolution: `useMemo` dependency list. Upstream dropped `autoSettleAfterDays`, `autoSettleOnMerge`, and `changeRequestSnapshotByKey` when settling moved to the server; the first two no longer exist in the component and the third is read only outside this memo. Kept upstream's list plus the fork's `sidebarThreadSortOrder` and `threadOrderByProject`, both of which the memo body reads.

conflicts.subject: fix(web): upload media in pull request descriptions
conflicts.resolution: same hoist as the earlier `server.ts` row: upstream moved `PullRequestServiceLive` earlier in the file, so the fork's hunk re-added it as a duplicate. Dropped the duplicate and moved the fork's only real change, `Layer.provide(PullRequestAttachmentStore.layer)`, onto the surviving declaration.
